subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw continue this stale branch as the narrow 24-hour cron timeline slice, request a fresh implementation against the current Control UI architecture, or pause for the broader calendar/week/editing design?
rationale: The implementation is a useful feature slice but now crosses current Control UI architecture, cron status compatibility, and the broader linked product request, so maintainer intent is needed before investing in repair versus replacement.

options.title: Request Fresh/Rebased Timeline Slice
options.body: Ask for a current-main branch that ports the 24-hour timeline to `ui/src/pages/cron`, preserves cron.status compatibility, and fixes scheduler/i18n blockers before review resumes.

options.title: Adopt And Repair This Branch
options.body: A maintainer can sponsor repair of this exact branch despite the conflict, accepting the larger rebase cost to preserve the contributor's existing work.

options.title: Pause For Broader Calendar Design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause this PR until daily/week calendar, editing, and stats scope are decided.

recommendation.title: Request Fresh/Rebased Timeline Slice
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main branch that ports the 24-hour timeline to `ui/src/pages/cron`, preserves cron.status compatibility, and fixes scheduler/i18n blockers before review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows the strongest combined Control UI and cron product-surface ownership signal for deciding the feature slice.
